    // mov rax, IEEE754(1.5) = 0x3FF8000000000000
    c = emit_byte(c, 0x48); c = emit_byte(c, 0xb8)
    c = emit_byte(c, 0x00); c = emit_byte(c, 0x00); c = emit_byte(c, 0x00); c = emit_byte(c, 0x00)
    c = emit_byte(c, 0x00); c = emit_byte(c, 0x00); c = emit_byte(c, 0xf8); c = emit_byte(c, 0x3f)
    // mov rdi, rax
    c = emit_byte(c, 0x48); c = emit_byte(c, 0x89); c = emit_byte(c, 0xc7)
    // call print_f64 (rel32)
    let call_site = c.len
    c = emit_byte(c, 0xe8)
    let rel = print_f64_off - (call_site + 5)
    c = emit_byte(c, rel & 0xFF)
    c = emit_byte(c, (rel >> 8) & 0xFF)
    c = emit_byte(c, (rel >> 16) & 0xFF)

    c = emit_byte(c, 0xbf); c = emit_byte(c, 0x00); c = emit_byte(c, 0x00); c = emit_byte(c, 0x00); c = emit_byte(c, 0x00)

fn main() -> i64 with IO, Mut, Panic, Div {
    // Build code: print_f64 at offset 0, then main stub
    var code = code_buffer_new()
    code = ast_emit_print_f64_builtin(code)
    let main_off = code.len
    code = emit_main(code, 0)  // print_f64 is at code offset 0

    let code_size = code.len
    let vaddr_base: i64 = 0x400000
    let code_file_off: i64 = 0x80  // After ELF header (64 bytes) + 1 program header (56 bytes) = 120 = 0x78, round up
    let entry_vaddr = vaddr_base + code_file_off + main_off

    // Build minimal ELF64 header
    var elf: [i8; 4096] = [0; 4096]

    // ELF magic: 7f 45 4c 46
    elf[0 as usize] = 0x7f as i8
    elf[1 as usize] = 0x45 as i8  // E
    elf[2 as usize] = 0x4c as i8  // L
    elf[3 as usize] = 0x46 as i8  // F

    // EI_CLASS=2 (64-bit), EI_DATA=1 (LE), EI_VERSION=1, EI_OSABI=0
    elf[4 as usize] = 2 as i8
    elf[5 as usize] = 1 as i8
    elf[6 as usize] = 1 as i8
    elf[7 as usize] = 0 as i8

    // e_type=2 (ET_EXEC), e_machine=0x3E (x86-64)
    elf = emit_u16(elf, 16, 2)
    elf = emit_u16(elf, 18, 0x3E)
    // e_version=1
    elf = emit_u32(elf, 20, 1)
    // e_entry
    elf = emit_u64(elf, 24, entry_vaddr)
    // e_phoff = 64 (right after ELF header)
    elf = emit_u64(elf, 32, 64)
    // e_shoff = 0 (no section headers)
    elf = emit_u64(elf, 40, 0)
    // e_flags = 0
    elf = emit_u32(elf, 48, 0)
    // e_ehsize = 64
    elf = emit_u16(elf, 52, 64)
    // e_phentsize = 56
    elf = emit_u16(elf, 54, 56)
    // e_phnum = 1
    elf = emit_u16(elf, 56, 1)
    // e_shentsize = 0
    elf = emit_u16(elf, 58, 0)
    // e_shnum = 0
    elf = emit_u16(elf, 60, 0)
    // e_shstrndx = 0
    elf = emit_u16(elf, 62, 0)

    // Program header (LOAD) at offset 64
    // p_type = 1 (PT_LOAD)
    elf = emit_u32(elf, 64, 1)
    // p_flags = 5 (PF_R | PF_X)
    elf = emit_u32(elf, 68, 5)
    // p_offset = 0
    elf = emit_u64(elf, 72, 0)
    // p_vaddr = vaddr_base
    elf = emit_u64(elf, 80, vaddr_base)
    // p_paddr = vaddr_base
    elf = emit_u64(elf, 88, vaddr_base)
    // p_filesz = code_file_off + code_size
    let total_file = code_file_off + code_size
    elf = emit_u64(elf, 96, total_file)
    // p_memsz = total_file
    elf = emit_u64(elf, 104, total_file)
    // p_align = 0x1000
    elf = emit_u64(elf, 112, 0x1000)

    // Copy code bytes into ELF at code_file_off
    var ci: i64 = 0
    while ci < code_size {
        elf[(code_file_off + ci) as usize] = code.bytes[ci as usize]
        ci = ci + 1
    }

    let elf_size = code_file_off + code_size

    // Write ELF to file using VM builtin
    let wr = write_file("/tmp/sprint235_f64.elf", elf, elf_size)
    if wr < 0 {
        print("FAIL: could not write ELF\n")
        return 1
    }

    print("PASS: ELF written size=")
    print_int(elf_size)
    print(" entry=0x")
    print_int(entry_vaddr)
    print(" code=")
    print_int(code_size)
    print("\n")
    0
}

/// Wave 2 Example: Causal Intervention with do-calculus
///
/// Demonstrates causal effect estimation using the do-operator.
/// Distinguishes between observation and intervention.
///
/// This example shows:
/// - Causal DAG specification
/// - do-operator for interventions
/// - Average treatment effect (ATE)
/// - Difference between P(Y|X) and P(Y|do(X))

fn main() {
    print("=== Causal Intervention: do-calculus ===\n")
    print("Example: Effect of Education on Income\n")

    print("\n=== Causal Model ===\n")
    print("Nodes: Ability, Education, Income\n")
    print("Edges:\n")
    print("  Ability -> Education\n")
    print("  Ability -> Income\n")
    print("  Education -> Income\n")
    print("  (Ability is a confounder)\n")

    print("\n=== Observational Data P(Income | Education) ===\n")
    // Observed correlation: Higher education -> higher income
    // BUT this includes effect of ability (confounder)

    let income_no_education: i64 = 30000   // Average income if Education=0
    let income_with_education: i64 = 50000 // Observed income if Education=1

    let obs_difference = income_with_education - income_no_education
    print("Average income without education: $")
    print_int(income_no_education)
    print("\n")
    print("Average income with education: $")
    print_int(income_with_education)
    print("\n")
    print("Observed difference: $")
    print_int(obs_difference)
    print("\n")

    print("\n=== Causal Effect P(Income | do(Education)) ===\n")
    // Using do-operator removes confounding
    // We set Education=1 AND remove the Ability -> Education path
    // This reveals the CAUSAL effect, not the confounded effect

    let causal_effect_education: i64 = 15000 // Actual causal effect
    print("Setting Education = 1 via intervention\n")
    print("This breaks the Ability -> Education pathway\n")
    print("Causal effect of education: $")
    print_int(causal_effect_education)
    print("\n")
    print("Difference from observation: $")
    print_int(obs_difference - causal_effect_education)
    print("\n")

    print("\n=== Interpretation ===\n")
    print("Observed effect ($")
    print_int(obs_difference)
    print(") includes:\n")
    print("  1. Direct causal effect of education: $")
    print_int(causal_effect_education)
    print("\n")
    print("  2. Confounding effect via ability: $")
    print_int(obs_difference - causal_effect_education)
    print("\n")

    print("\nThis shows why observational studies need causal reasoning!\n")
    print("We must identify confounders and account for them properly.\n")

    // Counterfactual reasoning
    print("\n=== Counterfactual: What if Alice had more education? ===\n")
    print("Observed: Alice without education earns $30k\n")
    print("Counterfactual prediction: If Alice had education, she would earn:\n")
    print("  $30k + $")
    print_int(causal_effect_education)
    print(" = $")
    print_int(30000 + causal_effect_education)
    print("\n")
}
